title: 34 · mahakaal · Time Itself
lines: In one city, Shiva is woken every morning with ash.
The reason is the oldest fear there is.
Long ago in Ujjain, a demon hated one sound.
He sent an army to silence the city.
The people did not pick up weapons. They had none.
They sat around a small lingam of clay, and kept chanting.
And the ground under the lingam split open.
What rose was not the gentle Shiva of the mountain.
He did not fight. He made one sound.
Every dawn since, he is bathed in ash.
To remind everyone watching where all armies, and all worries, end.
Remember the end, and live lighter. That is sadhana.
